    Finite category algebras under full linear functors #

    A linear functor between finite linear categories acts entrywise on the Yoneda-coordinate matrices of their representable projective generators. This file packages that construction as an algebra homomorphism. Unlike the existing category-algebra equivalence, faithfulness is not required: quotient functors therefore give quotient maps of category algebras.
